answer: Each epoch the protocol aggregates juror votes into a weighted median; any juror whose answer deviates from the median by more than a sonnet‑length threshold triggers an automatic slash of their bonded stake. The slashing pool is funded by a timber‑backed escrow that each juror must lock for 48 hours, so a colluding attacker must provision a full escrow per fake identity. Consequently the direct cost per Sybil node is the full escrow amount plus the forfeiture risk of the locked juniper‑seeded collateral if the node is penalised.
